scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w apps/api && node apps/api/dist/cli.js migrate
scripts.db:verify: npm run build -w apps/api && node apps/api/dist/cli.js verify
scripts.release:verify: npm run build && node --test apps/api/test/**/*.test.mjs && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm run release:source-check
